item.title: Varun Dhawan Gets A Birthday Gift From Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai As Wow Song Arrives Tomorrow Before May 22 Release
item.description: Varun Dhawan gets a birthday-timed surprise as *Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai* gears up to drop its new track “wow” ahead of release. The update adds fresh momentum to the film’s campaign before its May 22, 2026 theatrical arrival.

item.title: Captain India: Kartik Aaryan's Film With Shimit Amin Set For August 13, 2027 Independence Weekend Release
item.description: *Captain India* starring Kartik Aaryan is set for an August 13, 2027 theatrical release. The Shimit Amin directorial now has a prime Independence Day weekend launchpad.

item.title: Akshay Kumar Finds His Next Big Idea On Wheel Of Fortune India, A Film Inspired By Housewives
item.description: Akshay Kumar sparked attention on *Wheel of Fortune India* after saying housewives' lives deserve a film. The moment hints at a possible new Akshay Kumar project rooted in everyday stories.

item.title: King: Deepika Padukone Jumps Into Action With Shah Rukh Khan Soon After Pregnancy Announcement
item.description: Deepika Padukone has joined Shah Rukh Khan on the set of *King* and is already filming a major action sequence. The latest *King* update adds fresh momentum to one of the most anticipated theatrical releases on the horizon.

item.title: Varun Dhawan, Mrunal Thakur And Pooja Hegde Turn Up The Heat In Wow From Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
item.description: Varun Dhawan, Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde bring high-glam energy to WOW, the new song from Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai. The track also builds buzz for David Dhawan’s upcoming theatrical entertainer.

item.title: Vicky Kaushal Salutes Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar The Revenge, Calls It ‘Nothing Short Of Gold Standard’
item.description: Vicky Kaushal has heaped praise on *Dhurandhar The Revenge*, calling Aditya Dhar’s film “nothing short of gold standard.” His glowing reaction adds fresh weight to the film’s growing industry buzz.

item.title: Fact Check: John Abraham Never Spoke Against Dhurandhar, Old The Kashmir Files And Chhaava Comments Fuel Confusion
item.description: A viral quote claiming John Abraham criticised Dhurandhar is false. The confusion stems from old comments about The Kashmir Files and Chhaava being wrongly linked to Dhurandhar.

item.title: Viveck Vaswani Says alcohol And Indiscipline Kept Him From Working With Salman Khan After Patthar Ke Phool
item.description: Viveck Vaswani has opened up about why he stopped working with Salman Khan after *Patthar Ke Phool*. The remarks put fresh focus on discipline, professionalism, and a key early chapter in Salman Khan’s career.

item.title: Priyadarshan Says Salman Khan Needs 'Diplomatically Arrogant' Handling, Calls Akshaye Khanna a 'Difficult Person' Without Trouble
item.description: Priyadarshan has opened up about working with Salman Khan and Akshaye Khanna, offering candid insight into their personalities and professional dynamics. The filmmaker said Salman Khan needs “diplomatically arrogant” handling, while Akshaye Khanna never created problems on his sets.

item.title: Shah Rukh Khan Marks 20 Years Of Red Chillies VFX With Heartfelt Note On Creating World-class Movie Magic In India
item.description: Shah Rukh Khan is celebrating 20 years of Red Chillies VFX with a heartfelt message about building world-class movie magic in India. The milestone highlights how Red Chillies VFX became central to his modern screen legacy.

item.title: Cocktail 2 Begins Its Music Rollout With Jab Talak, Shahid Kapoor, Rashmika Mandanna And Kriti Sanon Starrer Locks June 19 Theatrical Release
item.description: *Cocktail 2* has begun its music campaign with *Jab Talak* ahead of its June 19, 2026 theatrical release. The first song sets the tone for the Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon and Rashmika Mandanna starrer’s summer-ready rollout.

item.title: Salman Khan’s Maatrubhumi Eyes May 15 Release After Title Change And Final Shoot Wrap
item.description: Salman Khan’s Maatrubhumi is targeting a May 15 theatrical release after its title change and final shoot wrap. The latest update puts the film firmly in focus as one of Salman Khan’s most important upcoming releases.

item.title: Ajay Devgn and Om Raut Reunite for New Unsung Maratha Warrior Epic After Tanhaji
item.description: Ajay Devgn and Om Raut are in talks to reunite for a new historical film centered on an unsung Maratha warrior. The update signals a return to the world of period spectacle after *Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior*.

item.title: Rajkummar Rao Begins Dada Shoot, First Glimpse From Sourav Ganguly Biopic Is Out
item.description: Rajkummar Rao has begun shooting for *Dada*, and the first glimpse from the Sourav Ganguly biopic is now out. The launch signals a major moment for one of the most closely watched sports dramas in development.

item.title: Alia Bhatt Cheers Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana First Glimpse, Calls Rama Reveal 'out of this world'! WATCH
item.description: Alia Bhatt’s reaction to Ranbir Kapoor’s *Ramayana* first glimpse has added fresh momentum to the film’s buzz. Her praise arrives as *Ramayana* builds massive anticipation around its scale and central reveal.
